items.title: Being locally the image of a dualizing complex is independent of the affine open covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a locally Noetherian scheme X and K in D(O_X), the lemma shows the equivalence of two conditions: for every affine open U = Spec(A) in X there is a dualizing complex omega_A for A whose tilde is isomorphic to K|_U; and there is an affine open covering X = union U_i with dualizing complexes omega_i for A_i whose tildes are isomorphic to the restrictions of K (statement lines 307-352). The proof assumes the second condition and takes an arbitrary affine open U = Spec(A): since the second condition implies K is quasi-coherent, Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-affine-compare-bounded produces omega_A in D(A) whose associated complex is isomorphic to K|_U, and it remains to show that omega_A is dualizing (proof lines 320-331). Because the U_i cover X, Schemes, Lemma labelled schemes-lemma-standard-open-two-affines gives a standard open covering U = D(f_1) union ... union D(f_m) with each D(f_j) standard in some U_i, and writing D(f_j) = D(g_j) for g_j in A_{i_j} one has A_{f_j} = (A_{i_j})_{g_j} and (omega_A)_{f_j} = (omega_i)_{g_j} in the derived category, again by the affine comparison lemma (proof lines 333-346). Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-dualizing-localize then makes each (omega_A)_{f_j} dualizing over A_{f_j}, and Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-dualizing-glue concludes that omega_A is dualizing (proof lines 348-352). Localising along a standard cover subordinate to the given one, and then glueing dualizingness from the localisations, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
